description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'ViewMyDetailsController' within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin module. The class handles redirection to the logged-in employee's personal details page by retrieving the employee number from the authenticated user context.

classes.name: ViewMyDetailsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for redirecting an authenticated user to their personal details page within the PIM module.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by obtaining the employee number of the current user and redirecting to their personal details URL.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the redirection to the personal details view based on the authenticated user's employee number.
